import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd()
def save(n,s):subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
f=p/'SUSTAINED-ORDINARY-ROUTES.md';s=f.read_text().replace('Fibers are nonempty for n>k (put k+1 first and the rest increasing)','Fibers are nonempty for n>k (the word 2,3,...,k+1,1,k+2,...,n has sole descent at position k)');save(f.name,s)
f=p/'ACTUALBRIEF.md';save(f.name,f.read_text().replace('maximum individual usage is8/12 (351165)','maximum individual usage is7/12 (351165 and352883)'))
prov=json.loads((p/'literal-provenance.json').read_text()); ids=json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids'];assert set(prov)==set(map(str,ids))
for v in prov.values():
 assert hashlib.sha256(v['raw_line'].encode()).hexdigest()==v['raw_sha256']
 assert hashlib.sha256(v['statement_token'].encode()).hexdigest()==v['token_sha256']
 assert json.loads(v['statement_token'])==v['statement']
 assert hashlib.sha256(v['statement'].encode()).hexdigest()==v['statement_sha256']
 assert v['newline']
assert set(json.loads((p/'results.json').read_text()))==set(prov)
previous='0'*64; attempts=[]
for idx,raw in enumerate((p/'guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)):
 o=json.loads(raw);assert o['seq']==idx and o['previous']==previous;previous=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
 if o['event']=='attempt':attempts.append(o)
 if o['event']=='success':assert hashlib.sha256((p/o['destination']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==o['sha256']
assert len(attempts)==11
for i in ids:assert sum(str(i) in x['routes'] for x in attempts)<=12
assert json.loads((p/'search-budget.json').read_text())['calls_used']==3
for i in range(1,4):assert isinstance(json.loads((p/f'search-response-{i}.json').read_text()),str)
receipts=[{'path':f.name,'exit':json.loads(f.read_text())['exit']} for f in sorted(p.glob('*.receipt.json'))]
save('handoff-audit.json',json.dumps({'provenance20_verified':True,'GET_hashchain_verified':True,'GET_payload_hashes_verified':True,'mathematical_computation':False,'completed_receipts':receipts,'known_failure_receipts':['registry_inventory.receipt.json'],'unpaid':'exact equality language, visual inspection, significance, independent review, formal, replay,paper,acceptance','terminal_manifest_exclusions':['SHA256-MANIFEST.json','handoff_manifest.receipt.json','handoff_manifest.output.txt']},indent=2))
print('provenance20/hashchain11/savedsearch3 verified; no mathematical tests')
